before.eval: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-queue-dock]'); if(!d) return 'no-dock'; const h=d.querySelector('button[aria-controls]'); if(h && h.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') h.click(); return 'ensured-expanded' })()

(() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-queue-dock]'); const li=[...d.querySelectorAll('li')].find(x=>/排队消息甲/.test(x.innerText||'')); if(!li) return 'no-item-jia'; const b=[...li.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')==='插话发送'); if(!b) return 'no-steer-btn'; b.click(); return 'clicked-steer-jia' })()
